question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Someone who attacks cherished ideas or traditional institutions
solution:
The correct answer is **'Iconoclast'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We need to substitute the given group of words with one word from the following options:
 
• Let's explore the **meanings **:
 
 
• **Believer **is a someone who has confidence in the truth, existence, or reliability of something(धार्मिक विश्‍वास रखने वाला व्‍यक्ति; विश्‍वासी, आस्तिक)
 
• **Iconoclast** is a person who does not believe in and is opposed to accepted ideas, traditions(स्वीकृत मान्यताओं, परंपराओं, रिवाजों आदि में विश्वास न करनेवाला; रूढ़िगत विचारों का विरोधी, रूढ़ि विरोधी)
 
• **Humanitarian **means concerned with trying to make people’s lives better and reduce suffering.मनुष्‍यों के जीवन में सुधार लाने और उनके कष्‍ट के प्रयत्‍न से संबंधित; मानवतावादी, लोकोपकारी)
 
• **Misanthrope **means a person who hates or avoids other people.(मनुष्य से घृणा करनेवाला; मानवद्वेषी)
 
 
 
• Therefore, from the given meanings, the one word is **'Iconoclast'.**
 
 
• ***Example: **Her dressing sense is quite unique; she is definitely an **iconoclast **in dressing style.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** option 2.**
